events.speaker: customer
events.text: The wine cooler in the den is making a rattling noise.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Friday morning works best, and for this repair my maximum is eight hundred U.S. dollars.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: My partner says the eight hundred U.S. dollars was the limit for another appliance. I think it was for this repair, but I cannot verify which of us is right.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I found the invoice: the eight hundred U.S. dollars was for the other appliance. My maximum for this repair is six hundred U.S. dollars.
